title: Code and results: Crohn's disease heritability by gut cell lineage in East Asian and European ancestry (pre-registered S-LDSC study)
description: Code, logs and result files for a pre-registered stratified LD score regression (S-LDSC / LDSC-SEG) study asking whether Crohn's disease heritability is distributed differently across gut cell lineages in East Asian and European ancestry. Primary result: joint Wald test of East Asian minus European differences in tau* across 8 lineages, W = 4.04, df = 8, p = 0.853 (no evidence of an ancestry difference). Pre-registration: doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/HQ4A8. All input data are public; see README for sources.
